evals.prompt: Make a shotlist for this scene: a couple argues in a kitchen at night.
evals.expected_output: Loads genius-shotlist-director, writes a self-contained HTML shotlist with Style Prefix, English Seedance prompts, CUT structure, and 15s targeting.

evals.prompt: Generate prompts for Seedance 2.0 from this treatment.
evals.expected_output: Triggers genius-shotlist-director and produces English-only prompt bodies for Seedance 2.0.

evals.prompt: Сделай режиссерский шотлист по этому сценарию.
evals.expected_output: Triggers despite Russian request language; prompt text inside HTML remains English.

evals.prompt: Genius-ShotlistDirector 把这段剧本拆成分镜提示词
evals.expected_output: Matches display/trigger name and produces shotlist HTML.

evals.prompt: Rewrite scene 4 of the shotlist and split prompt 6 into two 15s blocks.
evals.expected_output: Re-renders the HTML with revisions applied; preserves scene numbers where possible; does not only describe changes in chat.

evals.prompt: This confession scene needs about 45 seconds. Break it for Seedance.
evals.expected_output: One scene with multiple 15s prompts labeled like 3a/3b/3c and a single checkbox for the whole scene.

evals.prompt: Use this exact style prefix and make a shotlist: Style: noir grain. Lighting: single practical lamp. Script: ...
evals.expected_output: Uses the user custom Style Prefix verbatim in the top collapsible block and inside every copyable prompt.

evals.prompt: 输出 shotlist 到当前项目 genius_output
evals.expected_output: Writes a workspace-relative path such as genius_output/shotlist.html and never hardcodes /mnt/user-data/outputs/.

evals.prompt: Assemble the HTML with the skill build script from a scenes JSON.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/build_shotlist.py with assets/shotlist-template.html and emits GENIUS_RESULT path=...

evals.prompt: 用 Seedance API 直接生成 15 秒成片视频文件
evals.expected_output: Does not use this skill for video generation or Seedance API calls; skill only produces shotlist HTML prompts.

evals.prompt: 给这段剧本画分镜静帧图
evals.expected_output: Storyboard still images belong to image skills, not genius-shotlist-director.

evals.prompt: 帮我润色这段对白，让台词更自然，不要分镜
evals.expected_output: Pure script polish without a shotlist request should not trigger this skill.
